categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of experimental animal mouse models and related technical services. Its main business includes commercialized mouse model sales, custom model creation, custom breeding, functional pharmacology services, and antibody discovery platforms. It also operates subsidiaries focusing on antibody mouse models and property management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced gene editing technologies such as CRISPR/Cas9, ES targeting, and transgenic techniques to create genetically engineered mouse models. It has proprietary platforms for gene editing, drug screening, phenotypic analysis, breeding, germplasm preservation, and germ-free mouse and microbiota colonization. Automated breeding systems and strict quality control ensure high-quality animal models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include research institutions, top-tier hospitals, innovative pharmaceutical companies, and contract research organizations (CROs). The company serves both scientific research and industrial clients domestically and internationally, with a focus on oncology, metabolism, autoimmune, and neurological disease research. It has established relationships with global top 10 pharmaceutical companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production facilities in Jiangsu (Nanjing, Changzhou), Guangdong (Foshan), Sichuan (Chengdu), Beijing, and Shanghai, covering all major domestic biopharmaceutical clusters. It has expanded internationally with a subsidiary in the United States and a production facility in San Diego, as well as marketing presence in North America, Asia-Pacific, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the development, breeding, and supply of experimental animal models essential for drug discovery and preclinical research. It provides upstream R&D services and downstream product sales and technical support to pharmaceutical and research customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities are innovation and internationalization. It invests heavily in R&D projects such as the 'Spotted Mouse' gene knockout library, 'Wild Mouse' models with genetic diversity, germ-free and microbiota-colonized mice, and humanized antibody mouse models (NeoMabTM). It aims to expand model applications, improve model quality, and accelerate overseas market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of commercialized mouse models, custom model creation services, custom breeding services, and functional pharmacology testing. Additional income comes from licensing antibody discovery platforms and agency import/export services. The company confirms revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance of products or services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic players in the experimental animal mouse model industry, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a member of Asian and national mouse resource alliances. It competes with established global firms like Charles River and Taconic Biosciences but holds a strong position in China with the largest gene-engineered mouse resource library and nationwide production and sales network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 622 million, a 20.45% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 159 million, slightly down by 3.49%. The company maintains a strong asset base of RMB 2.58 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, accounting for over 15% of revenue. It has shown steady growth in domestic and international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its extensive proprietary gene-edited mouse model library, rapid and cost-effective model creation capabilities, and comprehensive one-stop service platform covering model creation, breeding, phenotypic and pharmacological evaluation. Its innovative models, such as humanized and wild mouse strains, provide more clinically relevant research tools. Nationwide production facilities and a growing international presence ensure high-quality, timely delivery and strong customer support.
